class: each case: `plan ROOT --json` read as `plan` (and `plan_wrote`: whether it wrote any file), `apply ROOT --out DIR` read as `applied` (published name -> text); for H11 each tree run on haro: `ran` (the ported) and `ran_ring` (the original)

cases.why: a keyword in another case is lowered; a symbol, a string and a comment are not
asserts:
if 1 = 1 see "If" ok   # If stays in a comment
x = :Next
for i = 1 to 2 next

cases.why: a built-in is spelled as Haro writes it; a function the tree defines is left as written
Softanza's c is t and its v is x, the same in every file
a bare name in a function is lettered by what it holds; the top level and a class body are not
asserts: 'nCount = 3' in applied['main.haro'] and 'tName = "a"' in applied['main.haro'] and 'aItems = [1, 2]' in applied['main.haro']
'oO = new P' in applied['main.haro'] and '? nCount + 1' in applied['main.haro']

cases.why: a method's bare assignment to an attribute of its class is not made a local: refused, named
asserts: any(r['old'] == 'count' and 'attribute' in r['why'] for r in plan['refused'])

cases.why: a rename landing on a name already in the scope is refused, named
asserts: any(r['old'] == 'cName' and r['new'] == 'tName' and 'already' in r['why'] for r in plan['refused'])

cases.why: Softanza's method-local _name_ is unwrapped and lettered as any local
asserts: '? nCount + 1' in applied['main.haro'] and '? tNew' in applied['main.haro']

cases.why: an unwrapped name that stands bare and is a keyword in any case is refused, named (the _new_ -> new kind)
asserts: sorted(r['old'] for r in plan['refused'] if 'keyword' in r['why'])

cases.why: a c name whose t name is a keyword-free word is renamed: tAnd is no keyword
plan writes nothing; apply writes every .ring as .haro, and rewrites its loads
a lettered local landing on a name already in its function is refused, named
asserts: any(r['old'] == 'count' and r['new'] == 'nCount' and 'already' in r['why'] for r in plan['refused'])

cases.why: an attribute written with its @ in a method is no refusal; Softanza's c is t there too
asserts: any(r['old'] in ('@cLast', '@tLast') for r in plan['refused'])

cases.why: a load on a first line after a byte order mark is rewritten, the mark kept
a $_name global is $name in every file
a $_name landing on a $name already in the tree is refused, named
asserts: any(r['old'] == '$_tTotal' and 'already' in r['why'] for r in plan['refused'])

cases.why: a call to a function the tree declares is written as it is declared
asserts: '? Shout("a")' in applied['main.haro'] and '? Shout("b")' in applied['main.haro']

cases.why: a name the tree declares in two spellings is refused, named
asserts: any(r['old'] == 'mix' and 'two spellings' in r['why'] for r in plan['refused'])

cases.why: :key = value is the pair [:key, value], the value read to its depth's comma or bracket
with --unit, a function in a file the unit never loads leaves the built-in respelled
the ported tree runs on haro and prints what the classic Ring surface printed
